انجبرت (form VII)
# اِنْجَبَرْتُ (injabartu) /in.d͡ʒa.bar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْجَبَرَ (injabara)
# اِنْجَبَرْتَ (injabarta) /in.d͡ʒa.bar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْجَبَرَ (injabara)
# اِنْجَبَرْتِ (injabarti) /in.d͡ʒa.bar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْجَبَرَ (injabara)
# اِنْجَبَرَتْ (injabarat) /in.d͡ʒa.ba.rat/: thir
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
